sloka: बहुना ऽत्र किमुक्तेन शृणु राम वचो मम।पश्यन्तु सकला लोकास्त्वां मां चैव रणाजिरे ।। ६.७९.१५ ।।
transliteration: bahunā 'tra kimuktena śṛṇu rāma vaco mama।paśyantu sakalā lokāstvāṁ māṁ caiva raṇājire ।। 6.79.15 ।।

translations.english: "Rama, why talk so much? Listen to my words. Let people in all worldssee you and me in the battlefield."
